_comment: Burst-MLE lifetime analysis, emtk app: AutoForm over MleViewModel (the Qt-free engine's session). Files and the fit-parameter table are data_table sections; every field has a description.

sections.description: The burst (.bur) tables of the analysis, in the order they are fitted. Click a row to select it, Delete removes it. Dropping .bur files or a folder adds them.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The burst table's file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the table is in.

sections.label: Detector
sections.description: The detector (colour) whose decay is shown and fitted. Define detectors in the Detector setup tab.

sections.label: Current file
sections.description: Index of the burst file whose decay is shown (0 is the first).

sections.label: Binning
sections.description: Micro-time binning factor: raw channels per bin. Too fine leaves bins empty, finer than the IRF resolves nothing. Auto picks one.

sections.label: Window start [bin]
sections.description: First micro-time bin of the fit window (after binning). Leave out the empty bins before the prompt.

sections.label: Window stop [bin]
sections.description: Micro-time bin after the last bin of the fit window. Leave out the noisy tail.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: A burst with fewer photons in the fit window is not fitted (its lifetime is left empty).

sections.label: VH shift [bin]
sections.description: Integer shift of the perpendicular decay, IRF and background relative to the parallel one.

sections.label: VV sub-bin shift
sections.description: Fractional shift of the parallel IRF (interpolated).

sections.label: VH sub-bin shift
sections.description: Fractional shift of the perpendicular IRF (interpolated).

sections.label: IRF start
sections.description: First IRF bin kept; earlier bins are zeroed. -1 keeps all.

sections.label: IRF stop
sections.description: Last IRF bin kept; later bins are zeroed. -1 keeps all.

sections.label: VV threshold
sections.description: IRF bins below this fraction of the parallel IRF maximum are zeroed (removes the noise floor).

sections.label: VH threshold
sections.description: IRF bins below this fraction of the perpendicular IRF maximum are zeroed.

sections.label: 2I*: P+2S
sections.description: Use the P+2S form of the 2I* statistic.

sections.label: BIFL scatter
sections.description: Treat the scattered light as burst-integrated fluorescence lifetime scatter (soft).

sections.title: Fit parameters
sections.description: Start value, fixed flag and fitted value of tau, gamma, r0 and rho. Double-click a start value to type; the check box fixes the parameter at its start value. A change refits the current decay.

columns.title: Parameter
columns.tooltip: tau: lifetime (ns); gamma: scatter fraction; r0: fundamental anisotropy; rho: rotational correlation time (ns).

columns.title: Start
columns.tooltip: Starting value of the optimiser (the value itself when the parameter is fixed).

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Hold the parameter at its start value.

columns.title: Result
columns.tooltip: Fitted value of the current decay.

sections.title: H2MM states
sections.description: Split the fit by the per-photon states of an H2MM run of the same burst folder.

sections.label: Split by H2MM state
sections.description: Fit each burst once more per H2MM state (Tau S0 (green) ... beside Tau (green)), after a fit of each state's decay pooled over the measurement, whose lifetime also starts the per-burst fits. Needs an H2MM run of this burst folder.

sections.label: State min photons
sections.description: A burst's state with fewer photons in the window is not fitted (its columns stay empty).
The pooled lifetime of each state and detector from the last Fit bursts (also written to Info/state_lifetimes.csv).

sections.label: Burst
sections.description: Index of the burst shown in the inspected-burst plot (all bursts of all loaded files).

columns.label: Series
columns.description: Detection colour (or state and colour in the segment-level analysis).

columns.label: Median tau [ns]
columns.description: Median fitted lifetime of the series.

columns.label: Mean tau [ns]
columns.description: Mean fitted lifetime of the series.
